semantic_policy.hard_activation: Only narrow exact phrases in the visual-obligation registry create hard duties. Legend, legendary, folklore, heroic, ancient, cursed, lost, prophecy, fate, lineage, returning king, memorate, contemporary legend, urban legend, variant, and legend cycle remain candidate-only unless the requester supplies a binding definition.
semantic_policy.visual_actuation: A legend-oriented still must connect a concrete place, object, vessel, structure, or body to an observable trace, transmission relation, causal event, or failed attempt; atmosphere and labels never substitute for that relation.
semantic_policy.cultural_boundary: Culture-specific variants keep their own place, people, material culture, and narrative lineage. These candidates do not authorize mixing sacred iconography, living ritual instructions, or unrelated traditions.
semantic_policy.evidence_boundary: Folklore archives and heritage sources support abstract visual relations and confusion limits, not the historical truth of a newly generated legend or reconstruction.

review_scope: Stage 5 retrieval prerequisites. Prior semantic descriptions and evidence are preserved in the immutable predecessor record.
